description: A first-order formula \(\varphi(\bar x)\) is preserved downwards between nonempty models of \(T\) if and only if it is equivalent modulo \(T\) to a universal formula in the same language and free-variable context.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.downward_preserved_iff_universal.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {T : L.Theory} {n : ℕ} (φ : L.Formula (Fin n)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.DownwardPreserved T φ ↔
    ∃ ψ, FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsUniversal ψ ∧ T ⊨ᵇ φ.iff ψ
